title.en: An Act Appropriating Funds to Cover the Deficit Incurred By the Constitutional Convention.

text.en:
The sum of one hundred and sixty-eighty thousand and five hundred pesos is hereby
appropriated, out of general funds not otherwise appropriated, to cover the deficit incurred by the
Constitutional Convention, as itemized below:
For payment of the expenses of the election of Delegates to the Constitutional Convention P122,000
For printing the Journal and other documents of the Constitutional Convention 25,000
For extra compensation for employees of the Philippine Legislature who rendered service to the Constitutional
Convention during the months of January and February, 1935, any provision to the contrary notwithstanding
10,000
For payment of bills rendered by Bureaus and offices, including miscellaneous expenses 7,500
For traveling expenses of the Delegates coming from and returning to their respective districts after the
sessions of the Convention 4,000

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, August 9, 1935.
